title: Choose the visual world for /Paradox/
question: The roll assigned The Issue. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Issue
options.lineage: Tokyo street-culture magazines (Popeye, Huge, Free & Easy) — the Bay's Japantown taste
options.thesis: /Paradox/ published as a magazine: every page a feature spread, every barber a cover story.
options.viewport: A magazine cover: giant /Paradox/ masthead, the nape photo as cover image, numbered cover lines (01 Cuts · 02 ĒDUCŌ · 03 Shop · 04 Five Shops), issue folio 'Est. 2015 — San Jose', Book sits as a cover-line sticker.
options.risk: Tips into costume if the magazine grammar is decoration instead of structure (folios, feature numbers, captions must do real navigation work).

raised.raise: Two inks and one spot, no midtones in chrome: photos print as ink halftone and develop to full colour as they enter the page.
One vertical folio rail rules every page: page number plus the 2011 → 2126 year axis ('a hundred years is the horizon') as you scroll.
Absence is designed: the shop index draws every shop's open/booking state, including the newest, as deliberately as the lit ones.

options.label: The Drop
options.lineage: streetwear drop sites and lookbooks (Kith, Fear of God, Aimé)
options.thesis: Each shop and each barber released like a collection drop.
materials: the slash as the only ornament
options.viewport: Full-bleed photo carousel, tiny tracked nav, /Paradox/ wordmark centered, 'Book' bottom-right.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most premium barbershop and streetwear sites land.

options.label: Weimar Cabaret Bill
options.thesis: The shop's programme as an evening bill in acid yellow and black.
options.viewport: A black field with an angular barber portrait, the five shops ranked as acts.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the Bay barber audience has no relationship with Weimar theatre.
options.risk: Reads as a theatre poster, not a barbershop.
options.kept: Total two-ink commitment, no grey chrome.

options.label: Mesophotic Deep Dive
options.thesis: Scroll as a descent from 2011 to the hundred-year horizon.
options.viewport: A diver-depth axis with the founding year at the surface.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an ocean metaphor buries the barbers and the shops.
options.kept: One vertical axis ruling every line of copy.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: Shop info as a lit LED totem.
options.viewport: Five shops as a stadium scoreboard.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cold instrument language against a warm, people-first craft.
options.kept: Designing the unlit states as carefully as the lit ones.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: The /P/ slash as a live typographic specimen.
options.viewport: A giant /P/ morphing under a weight slider.
options.case: Fuses poorly: barbers and clients are not type nerds.
options.kept: Hierarchy by extreme scale contrast alone.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: The Bay folds like a quilt, each shop a dreaming district.
options.viewport: A folded night map of the five shops.
options.case: Fuses poorly: whimsy fights 'precision is the brand'.
options.risk: Needs illustration assets that do not exist.
options.kept: Each shop keeps its own district identity within one map.

options.label: Shareware Installer
options.thesis: Booking as a linear install wizard.
options.viewport: A grey dialog asking which shop to install.
options.case: Fuses poorly: irony undermines an elevated brand.
options.kept: A linear, can't-get-lost booking step: pick a shop, go.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark, premium barbershop site executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-screen photo hero with wordmark, tagline and a Book button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other premium barbershop by design.
